heading: Inside the house, start to finish.
lede: Walls, ceilings, doors, and trim. We move what we can and cover the rest.
includes: Doors, door frames, and window trim
Filling nail holes and small cracks
Caulking gaps where trim meets the wall
Priming stains and patches so they don't show through

faq.question: Can we stay home while you paint?
faq.answer: Yes, most people do. We work in one area at a time, so you can use the rest of the house. We open windows and run a fan when we can.

faq.question: Do you paint ceilings?
faq.answer: Yes. It's best to paint the ceiling at the same time as the walls.

faq.question: What about small repairs?
faq.answer: We fill nail holes, dents, and small cracks as part of the job. If we find bigger damage, we'll show you and give you a separate price.

faq.question: How many coats do we get?
faq.answer: Two coats, with primer where it's needed. A big color change may need a third. If so, we'll tell you before we start.

steps.title: Cover and clear
steps.body: We move furniture to the middle of the room and cover it. Floors get drop cloths. Outlet covers come off.

steps.title: Patch and sand
steps.body: We fill holes and cracks, then sand them smooth. This is what makes the wall look good.

steps.title: Prime what needs it
steps.body: Stains, patches, and big color changes get primer first. We only prime where it's needed.

steps.title: Two coats
steps.body: We brush the edges and corners by hand, then roll the rest.

stepsLede: Most of a good paint job is the prep. That's what makes the lines straight and the walls smooth.
